name: chip
title: Chip
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: An outlined pill holding a whole phrase. Use for suggestions, presets and filters — not for single words.

hairline.purpose: An outlined pill carrying a whole phrase.
hairline.antiExampleWhy: A chip holds a phrase, not a word; a one-word chip should be a button or a badge.

docs: Set `interactive={false}` for a chip that only reports; it renders a <span> so it stays out of the tab order.
